fields.label: Are you at this time subject to any internal investigation (such as an ongoing Employee Relations [ER] review) with your present employment?*
Are you currently an employee or contingent worker of TIAA or any subsidiary or affiliate within the TIAA family of companies?*
Are you legally authorized to work in the US?*
Can you submit verification of both your identity and your authorization to work in the U.S. pursuant to the U.S. Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 within 72 hours of starting employment?*

Do you currently have a close personal relationship with (1) any associate of TIAA or its subsidiaries, (2) any contingent (contract) worker (CW), or (3) any owner, officer, and/or director of any vendor that is materially involved with TIAA or its subsidiaries? A “close personal relationship” is any of the following relationships between one individual and another individual: •Spouses, partners, parents, stepparents, children, stepchildren, siblings, mothers-in-law, fathers-in-law, daughters-in-law and sons-in-law, brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law, siblings-in-law; or •Member of your household or the household of any of your relatives listed above (excluding tenants or workers); or •A personal relationship that creates a conflict on its face or under a common sense standard (for example: dating between manager and subordinate; ongoing alimony obligations between former spouses in a reporting relationship).*

Were you referred to this position by a Government Official? *A Government Official is defined as any elected, appointed, or employed official at any level of federal, state, or local government worldwide, who has or will have either direct or indirect decision-making authority that impacts TIAA or any TIAA subsidiary/affiliate. This includes decision-making employees of businesses with majority government ownership, public international organizations, and political parties or candidates for office. Non-decision-making employees of public institutions such as public university systems are not considered covered Government Officials.*

Are you a relative of a Government Official? *A Government Official is defined as any elected, appointed, or employed official at any level of federal, state, or local government worldwide, who has or will have either direct or indirect decision-making authority that impacts TIAA or any TIAA subsidiary/affiliate. This includes decision-making employees of businesses with majority government ownership, public international organizations, and political parties or candidates for office. Non-decision-making employees of public institutions such as public university systems are not considered covered Government Officials.*
Have you ever had your securities license revoked?*

Were you, or do you have an immediate family member who is currently or has within the last three years been a partner or employee of Pricewaterhouse Coopers (PwC) LLP, KPMG, Grant Thorton (GT), Cohn Reznick or Carr, Riggs & Ingram, LLC (CRI)?*
Will you presently or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g. H1B Visa, CPT EAD, OPT EAD)?*

Would you be willing to disclose (in a post offer situation and as necessary) information related to your political contributions as required by SEC Rule 206(4)-5 , which requires employers to collect this information in order to help address "pay-to-play" practices? To learn more about the SEC Rule, type or copy and paste the following into your web browser. http://www.sec.gov/rules/final/2010/ia-3043.pdf*
Have you ever been terminated from a job?*

TIAA Talent Acquisition uses an interview scheduling tool to coordinate conversations between recruiters and hiring teams. If you are selected for an interview, TIAA Talent Acquisition Team will send you communication by text and email to quickly schedule an interview. You may select your communication preference below for this application only. If you select “No” to receiving a text message, you will NOT have an option to change this selection later for this application only. TIAA Talent Acquisition will only send you information regarding employment opportunities.* By my selection below, I consent to receiving periodic automated text messages for this application only (including both transactional and marketing SMS and MMS) related to my employment application and job-related correspondence. I understand that these related two-way text messages exchanges in which I participate may originate from different numbers and agree with my selection below that these exchanges may be retained, shared, and processed by the send and/or its business partners. I accept the associated Terms and Conditions and understand that my consent is not required. Standard message and data rates may apply.
